runtime_contract.reward: Preserve endpoint-only partial-interval omission; no new shaping.
runtime_contract.architecture: Project feedforward PPO v1: separate 512/128/64 ELU actor and critic, actor 24 scalars, critic 61 scalars; no RNN. Upstream recurrent reference remains distinct.
runtime_contract.architecture_status: Development implementation choice; all future study learning arms must share the same frozen architecture.
runtime_contract.terminal: One done per job; absorbing slots excluded from PPO and normalizers; no terminal value bootstrap; full-cohort resets between jobs only.
runtime_contract.witness: Existing scripted-phase witness retained; added controller-independent contact/withdrawal witness tested separately in both paths.
runtime_contract.initialization_cost: All initialization physics env steps / decimation charged in addition to every rollout slot.

required: same complete-job outcomes and terminal times
same scripted and controller-independent witness outputs
identical action/physical trajectories or explicitly failed equivalence

support_checks.acceptance: All requested initializations valid; at least one completion at each non-nominal bin/value and nominal group under the fixed retry; representative witnesses in each fault family remain required. Sampled coverage never proves all points of a continuous interval.
support_checks.on_failure: Preserve every outcome and keep the fault-support gate open; do not tune the script or change the geometry/force limit to pass.

capacity.planned_final_path_measurement: After physical parity, 5 cohorts at the selected size, yielding 20 PPO updates including shorter cohort-end chunks. Treat all weights and transitions as development probe cost.

protocol_freeze: Only after all required gates pass; the registered physics-timestep refinement development controls remain mandatory and final-test cases stay closed.
scope_and_limitations: Implementation and development verification plan, not scientific effect-size evidence.
No learning pilot budget has been selected or launched; selection depends on gates and remaining block time.
